subject: Reminder: Payment Due for Your Recent Hotel Booking
body: Dear [Name], This is a friendly reminder that payment for your recent hotel booking at [Hotel Name] is due by [Due Date]. Please log in to your account on our website to complete the payment process securely. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team at [Contact Information]. Thank you for choosing to stay with us! Best regards, [Hotel Name]
